You change the sliders without updating the model ("✚ Sliders on result").

strings.ViTMatte liczy półprzezroczystą alfę tyl: ViTMatte computes semi-transparent alpha only in the zone – a band around the whole outline that follows the object; you set the band width with band points (whiskers: outside / inside, 0 = a gap, e.g. skin); the result is applied over a base of your choice: the MatAnyone2 version from stage 3 or mask 1+2 (then the stage works right after stages 1 + 2). A group (object + parts) is computed by the main object as a whole with a seam. A / B / difference comparison – below.
